name: bang-actions
description: Turns `! cmd` suggestions in Claude's answers into one-press Run buttons above the prompt. A press runs the command with bash in the session folder and submits the output as the plugin's prompt, so Claude's next turn starts on it and the run stays in the transcript as a compact exit-code row (ctrl+o shows the whole output). A command your Bash permission rules deny gets a two-press button; nothing ever fills the prompt box.
